items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Oh, John. John, I played some drum for him, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Yeah, I played that drum for that boy there, what's his name again? What's his name again? I don't know. He played with Dee Dee Dee. He played with Dee Dee some time. He used to play with Dee Dee Dee.
John, I played some drum for him.
